summary: Implemented the window title setting in the rich repo. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the title sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and a Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, writing Control.title when is_terminal and returning True/False. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked). Not verified: I did not run pytest or Black, per instructions. Nothing committed. Interpretation choices: workflow 1's "show_cursor is true" read as the is_terminal check used by show_cursor; console test skip uses sys.platform == "win32".
